# Product Disposal Information

[](javascript:window.print() "Print this article")

To properly dispose of any DDL product once it reaches its end of life, check your local authority for recycling advice and facilities.

The separate collection and recycling of your product at the time of disposal will help conserve natural resources and ensure that it is recycled in a manner that protects human health and the environment.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[United States](https://www.epa.gov/smm-electronics/regulations-initiatives-and-research-electronics-stewardship)

[US Environmental Protection Agency](http://www.epa.gov/)

[State Electronics Laws](http://www.electronicsrecycling.org/?page_id=37)

-Twenty-five states currently have electronics recycling laws. The National Center for Electronics Recycling (NCER) developed [an interactive map](http://www.ecycleclearinghouse.org/content.aspx?pageid=10) that helps to find out detailed information on state regulations, including a brief summary and link to the laws as well as key dates.
